Provision of safe drinking water and three phase power supply to Balapalatippa H O Erramatam GP, Kothapalli Mandal, Nandyal District. The area is facing acute water scarcity due to deep groundwater levels and insufficient solar-based supply. With a population of 135 in Janalagudem habitation, the existing infrastructure is inadequate. A borewell, pump set, and pipeline are essential to ensure uninterrupted water supply for public health and development.

The project aims to provide sustainable drinking water and three phase power supply to Janalagudem H O Erramatam GP, Kothapalli Mandal, Nandyal District. With a population of 112 relying on inadequate solar pump sets, the village faces acute water shortages due to depleting groundwater. The proposal includes a borewell, pump set, and pipeline network to ensure consistent and safe water supply.
